decisions.reason: Although it fits the firm’s hearing-technology knowledge base, its disappearance from the website by 2024 suggests weak traction or replacement, so management would reallocate resources to stronger adjacent products it can scale and improve more effectively.

This product was close to existing capabilities but was no longer mentioned in 2024, indicating that early market learning likely did not justify continued support versus other better-performing in-ear solutions.

The vacuum thermoforming unit remained prominently marketed in both 2023 and 2024 and builds directly on the firm’s established equipment, materials, and laboratory process knowledge, making it a strong candidate for continued improvement and commercialization.

Even though it received its own page in 2024, the orthopedic shoe last is too far from the firm’s core dental and hearing knowledge base, so absorptive-capacity logic suggests limited ability to refine it efficiently compared with core-domain innovations.

The post-curing unit is closely related to the firm’s digital production and device-processing capabilities, and as a new 2024 launch it merits continued support because the firm has the internal R&D and process knowledge to learn from early use and improve it.
